style: Dark painterly digital illustration for a premium online slot game, horror-industrial deep-sea mood. Heavily desaturated palette: abyss black #02060A, trench teal-grey #0B1418, silt #1E2C31, aged brass #B8874A. The only strong light is bioluminescent cyan #3FE0D0 coming from upper-centre-left, behind the subject. Visible brush texture and fine film grain, matte, no glossy plastic look, no lens flare.
negative: No text, no letters, no logos, no UI buttons, no slot reels, no symbols, no frames around the image, no watermark, no bright saturated colours, no cartoon style.

jobs.prompt: Background plate, far layer: a vast abyssal trench seen from inside, cliff walls dissolving into black fog, faint god-rays of cyan light filtering from far above, drifting marine snow. Mostly empty dark centre where the slot grid will sit.

Background plate, middle layer on a pure black background for later cut-out: jagged basalt rock formations and hydrothermal vent chimneys on the left and right edges only, centre left empty and black, faint cyan rim light on the rock edges.

A colossal eldritch sea serpent leviathan, mostly in shadow, its huge head and open jaw looming from the fog, only its eyes and a lure organ glowing bioluminescent cyan, which is the main light source of the scene. On a pure black background for cut-out. Seen from slightly below, menacing, enormous scale.

Front orthographic view of a heavy reel enclosure for a 5x5 slot grid: forged basalt and riveted submarine steel, weathered brass trim, barnacles and corrosion. The inside is a perfectly empty black rectangle. The left pillar contains an empty vertical glass depth-gauge tube. The bottom lintel contains a long empty channel and five round carved seal sockets. Top-right corner has a round sonar dial porthole. Lit by cyan light from upper-centre-left. On a pure black background.
